integrity: Original symbolic argument with two independent finite checkers; finite tests do not establish universal results; no independent external mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the regular module of the elementary-abelian group of rank five over characteristic-two finite fields; no extrapolation to other group ranks or other modules. Bibliographic equivalences may exist under historical terminology.
title: Complete multiplication-rank stratification of a five-generator elementary-abelian group algebra
